parsing_traps.detail: Figueroa appears at US$98.1m in marketing summary (page 27, Cushman & Wakefield JLL valuation) and at US$85,703k in the audited Portfolio Statement (page 125, held-for-sale at estimated net sale consideration). market_valuation = US$85,703,000 (audited). The portfolio headline of US$913.8m uses the marketing figure (815.7+98.1=913.8); audited total = 815,700+85,703 = 901,403 US$'000.

parsing_traps.trap: Per-property NPI from bar charts (US$ million, convert ×1,000,000)
parsing_traps.detail: NPI and GR per property are disclosed in bar charts rendered as markdown tables by Datalab on pages 30-36. Values are in US$ million (not '000). Applied ×1,000,000 to convert to absolute. All 7 active/held-for-sale properties captured including Centerpointe (page 30: GR 9.8m, NPI 4.9m). Penn NPI from inline text on page 35 ('8.9 8.6 8.5' for 2023/2024/2025). Figueroa NPI from bar chart page 33 (0.5m).

parsing_traps.trap: Peachtree and Plaza absent from Tier-C valuation table
parsing_traps.detail: Both divested in FY2025 and show '–' (zero) in the 2025 column of page 124. Their partial-year P&L is included in the consolidated Statement of Total Return (the ~US$3.9m NPI gap noted in REFERENCE.md §4). status=divested; market_valuation=null as at 31 Dec 2025.

parsing_traps.trap: Statement of Portfolio (page 107) is in US$ million not '000
parsing_traps.detail: The front-matter Statement of Portfolio (page 107) uses US$ million format (e.g. 230,400 means 230.4m). The audited Note 6 on pages 124-125 uses US$'000 (e.g. 230,400 means 230,400,000 absolute). Used pages 124-125 as authoritative source.

reconciliation.gross_revenue_gap_explanation: Per-property GR for the 7 FY2025 portfolio properties (incl. held-for-sale Figueroa) sums to US$105.8m (Michelson 22.4m + Phipps 17.5m + Exchange 25.4m + Penn 15.5m + Centerpointe 9.8m + Figueroa 11.7m + Diablo 3.5m). The consolidated Statement total is US$113.914m. The gap of ~US$8.1m is partial-year revenue from Plaza (divested Feb 25 2025, ~2 months) and Peachtree (divested May 27 2025, ~5 months) — both classified as status=divested with null GR since full-year figures are not individually disclosed in the report. The ~US$8.1m gap is consistent with ~2 months of Plaza (~US$1.7m at 2024 run rate of US$10.1m/12) plus ~5 months of Peachtree (~US$6.4m at 2024 run rate of US$15.4m/12).
reconciliation.npi_gap_explanation: Per-property NPI for the 7 FY2025 portfolio properties sums to US$49.3m (Michelson 13.6m + Phipps 10.2m + Exchange 10.5m + Penn 8.5m + Centerpointe 4.9m + Figueroa 0.5m + Diablo 1.1m). The consolidated Statement total is US$53.178m. The gap of ~US$3.9m is partial-year NPI from Plaza and Peachtree (divested in FY2025), not individually disclosed.

property_valuation.discrepancy_explanation: Marketing headline (US$913.8m, page 27) uses Cushman & Wakefield valuation for Figueroa (US$98.1m). Audited statement uses estimated net sale consideration (US$85.703m). Difference = US$12.4m.
